en: Multiview color postcard of the Romanian spa resort area Oradea–Băile Felix. It shows an outdoor thermal pool with an A‑frame pavilion, a tall modernist hotel, and landscaped parks with paths, flower beds and water‑lily ponds. A yellow title band on the front reads "Oradea‑Băile Felix." The reverse is in Romanian with address fields, publisher credits, a price in lei, and a stamp box numbered 16924.
